div.h3: How Home Loan EMI is Calculated in India: Formula, Amortization, and Prepayment Hacks
div.p: A comprehensive guide explaining the reducing balance method used by Indian banks (SBI, HDFC, ICICI) and how part-payments reduce total interest outflow by lakhs of rupees.

div.h3: SIP vs Lumpsum Mutual Fund Investing in India: Compounding and Rupee Cost Averaging
div.p: Understand SIP and lump-sum cash flows, rupee cost averaging and compounding assumptions without treating projected returns as a performance guarantee.

div.h3: Buying Gold Jewellery in India: Hallmark HUID, 3% GST, and Making Charges Explained
div.p: Never overpay for gold jewellery again. Understand BIS 6-digit HUID hallmarks, wastage (VA), making charges, and the compulsory 3% GST on billing.

div.h3: CTC vs In-Hand Salary Explained: EPF, Gratuity, Professional Tax, and Income Tax
div.p: Understand CTC costs, PF, gratuity reserve, variable pay and professional tax, and distinguish a pre-income-tax-TDS estimate from actual bank credit.

div.h3: Home Loan EMI and Salary Affordability: A Practical Planning Guide
div.p: Understand home loan EMI, compare tenures and test affordability against take-home salary, existing repayments and a realistic household budget.

div.h3: Personal Loan EMI: Flat Rate vs Reducing Balance Explained
div.p: Compare flat and reducing-balance personal loan quotes using EMI, total repayment, fees and the amount actually received.

div.h3: Car Loan EMI: Down Payment, On-Road Price and Tenure
div.p: Work out the financed vehicle amount, compare down payments and tenures, and separate car loan EMI from the full cost of ownership.

div.h3: Loan Prepayment: Reduce EMI or Shorten Tenure?
div.p: Understand how a part-payment reduces outstanding principal, why tenure reduction and EMI reduction differ, and what this calculator actually models.

div.h3: FD Maturity Calculation: Quarterly Compounding, Interest and TDS
div.p: Calculate cumulative fixed-deposit maturity, understand quarterly compounding and distinguish gross interest, TDS and final tax liability.

div.h3: RD Maturity Calculation: Monthly Deposits, Compounding and TDS
div.p: See how each recurring-deposit instalment earns for a different period, calculate gross maturity and apply the corrected bank-interest TDS context.

div.h3: SIP Return Calculation: Contributions, Compounding and Assumptions
div.p: Understand the monthly SIP future-value formula, test assumed returns and distinguish a projection from an actual mutual fund return.

div.h3: PPF Maturity and the 5th-of-the-Month Interest Rule
div.p: Understand annual PPF compounding, the monthly fifth-day balance rule and why a 7.1% maturity projection is an assumption, not a permanently fixed rate.

div.h3: NPS Corpus, Annuity and Pension: Calculation and Exit-Rule Context
div.p: Separate NPS corpus growth from annuity income and understand why sector, exit type and corpus size matter more than a generic 60/40 rule.

div.h3: Gratuity Calculation: Salary, Service Years and Estimate Limits
div.p: Understand the salary-and-service gratuity formula, the calculator’s covered and uncovered illustrations, and the limits of its eligibility and tax estimates.
